Card Q&A.a: Yes, you can suspend either player's Digimon.
Card Q&A.q: Can I use this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect to suspend either my Digimon or my opponent's Digimon?
Can I activate this card’s inherited effect even if my opponent's Digimon and the Digimon that has this card in its digivolution cards are deleted at the same timing?

Effect: [On Play] [When Digivolving] You may suspend 1 Digimon. Then, if this Digimon is suspended, ＜De-Digivolve 1＞ 1 of your opponent's Digimon and, until the end of your opponent's turn, their effects can't return this Digimon to hands or decks or affect it with ＜De-Digivolve＞ effects.
Inherited Effect: [All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When this Digimon deletes your opponent's Digimon in battle, trash their top security card.
